card.name: Digits inside risk statistics
card.fires_on: A digit inside a number in a risk statistic, mostly the first decimal of a confidence interval bound after '1.' in a relative-risk statement. Also a digit in a year, in a sentence about likelihood of preterm birth.

modes.label: Confidence interval digit
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in the lower bound of a 95% CI for a relative risk.
modes.example: randomized to one of the AEDs had approximately twice the risk (adjusted Relative Risk 1.8, 95% CI:1.<<2>>, 2.7) of suicidal

modes.label: Digit in a year
modes.description: A digit within a year in a sentence comparing how likely an outcome is.
modes.example: about 5 times as likely to be preterm in 20<<1>>0.| | ||For more detailed
